lines.vo: Why does one quick text wreck your whole study session?
That's not a quick text. That's a focus reset.
Jay blocks out a phone free hour in his Study and Success Planner.
lines.cap: Jay blocks out a phone-free hour in his Study & Success Planner.

lines.vo: Researchers who tracked office workers found interrupted tasks often weren't picked back up right away.
On average, it took around twenty three minutes to get back to the original task.
lines.cap: On average, it took around 23 minutes to get back to the original task.

lines.vo: And people worked faster after interruptions, but reported more stress.
So batch your messages, and guard one focus block at a time.
One block, check the box, phone stays away. That's how you stay on track.

hook: One text *wrecks* your whole study session
